query: 54‑year‑old male inpatient: among male inpatients aged 49–59 with ischemic stroke, what is the 75th percentile of the 72‑hour lab instability score? For the high‑instability stroke group report LOS, mortality, and compare critical lab rates to age‑matched controls.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY los) AS high_instability_score_percentile, SUM(CASE WHEN d.icd_code = '304' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(d.icd_code), 0) AS mortality_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN l.itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE category = 'Critical') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(l.itemid), 0) AS critical_lab_rate FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id JOIN labevents l ON a.subject_id = l.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age = 54 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) >= 2015 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.dischtime) <= 2016 AND (d.icd_code = '304' OR d.icd_code = '305') AND (l.itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE category = 'Critical'));
